findings.title: Data quality validation present
findings.evidence: The file loads data and uses it for training/output without any explicit quality check first.  Quoted: 'applications = pd.read_csv("silver/CreditApplications_validated_20240901.csv")'
findings.reasoning: The file loads data with pd.read_csv, uses it to train a model and write outputs, but contains no explicit data quality check such as assertions, validation calls, or null/duplicate/range checks before those uses.

remediation.description: Add an explicit data quality validation check before training by verifying required columns and rejecting missing values in the loaded applications data.
remediation.fix:
python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
path = Path('CreditScoring_Pipeline/02_TrainScoringModel.py')
text = path.read_text()
old = '''def main() -> None:
    applications = pd.read_csv("silver/CreditApplications_validated_20240901.csv")

    feature_cols = ["annual_income", "existing_debt", "credit_history_months"]
    X = applications[feature_cols].values
    y = applications["defaulted"].values
'''
new = '''def main() -> None:
    applications = pd.read_csv("silver/CreditApplications_validated_20240901.csv")

    feature_cols = ["annual_income", "existing_debt", "credit_history_months"]
    required_cols = feature_cols + ["defaulted"]
    missing_cols = [col for col in required_cols if col not in applications.columns]
    if missing_cols:
        raise ValueError(f"Missing required columns: {missing_cols}")
    if applications[required_cols].isnull().any().any():
        raise ValueError("Data quality check failed: missing values found in required columns")

    X = applications[feature_cols].values
    y = applications["defaulted"].values
'''
if old not in text:
    raise SystemExit('target block not found')
path.write_text(text.replace(old, new))
PY
